name: Álvaro VIII of Kongo
role: King of the Kingdom of Congo
legacy: In 1667, he sent his ambassador, Anastasius, to Luanda, to negotiate a treaty that ceded to the Portugueses the right to exploit the mines of Kongo, located in the provinces of Mbamba and Mpemba

checks.lead: Alvaro VIII (Mvemba a Mpanzu; 1630 – June 1669), of the House of Kinlaza, was king of the Kingdom of Kongo, from 1666 to 1669.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
